author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.62 shipped: Custom Preset Ranges settle gate + failure reset
summary: Custom Preset Ranges settle gate + failure reset
why: The card's premise (redundant write) was refuted: a 120 s gate already existed. The real risk, measured: a rare (1/544) local rejection while setpoints lag a preset change, and rejections never reset, marching zone_3 toward the 3-strike latch; a first visit in that window could also save a wrong original, reachable when zones 1/2 roll out, which the operator wants soon. Anchoring on the observed change covers every writer; the trip-wire keeps a feed-split hold from being silent.
implications: Shipped HVAC-S10-STALE-RANGE-AFTER-PRESET-CHANGE-1 at v5.103.62; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.62.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If a zone_3 S10 write lands within 600 s of a preset change, if s10_settle_held fires on zone_3, or if apply failures rise after rollout of zones 1/2.

refs.release_notes: S10 waits 600 s after any observed preset change before writing or capturing originals; confirmed success resets the apply-failure count; 4 h held trip-wire notifies. See docs/readmes/README_v5.103.62.md
